messages:
Ana (DevRel): Quick sync planning an OSS starterkit mini-lab for community devs. 30m live, repo + short blog. Goal: teach a tiny refapp and show a 2-config benchmark.
Noor (Content): Good. Ill draft blog (600-800w) + 3 social cards. Angle: "from clone to demo in 5min".
Ethan (Bench): For narrative: compare hosted-small vs local-quant. Report p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens. CSV + single PNG.
Maya (Growth): I'll own RSVP and inbound flow: Typeform -> HubSpot list -> Segment -> SFDC. Need fields: name, email, org, role, deployment preference.
Luis (OSS): Repo will have examples/mini-lab, CONTRIBUTING, Dockerfile. Add GH Action to run examples smoke test.
Ana (DevRel): Keep demo to 4 commands. Include a "run on hosted" quick link for folks without GPUs.
Noor (Content): Draft outline: setup (2m), build (12m), run bench (8m), next steps + CTA (8m). Will share by Tue.
Ethan (Bench): Bench script: 40 requests per config, record latency with ms timestamps. Will push bench.csv to /benchouts.
Maya (Growth): RSVP fields include GDPR checkbox and timezone. Routing: HubSpot list = "starterkit-mini-lab-2026". Webhook to Segment.
bot-scheduler: Poll: rehearsal slot options Mon 9am PT, Tue 3pm PT. Voting open 24h.
Ana (DevRel): Mon 9am PT works for me.
Noor (Content): Mon 9am good.
Luis (OSS): Pushing initial branch now: refs/heads/starterkit-mini-lab. Will add README badges.
Maya (Growth): I'll draft email reminders (48h and 1h) and follow-up with repo + bench results.
Ana (DevRel): Owners recap: Noor=content, Ethan=bench, Maya=rsvp/routing, Luis=repo, Ana=host. Aim to publish assets 48h pre-event. :rocket:
